basic_details.job_title: Gujarat Biotechnology University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Senior Research Fellow, Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Biotechnology University (GBU), Gandhinagar, an initiative of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat, has invited applications for one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and one Project Associate-I post on a Department of Biotechnology (DBT) funded project. SRF pay is Rs. 42,000 + 27% HRA and Project Associate-I pay is Rs. 31,000 + 27% HRA (or as per funding agency norms). Applications go through an online form, on or before 4 December 2026.

vacancy_details.Pay (per month): Rs. 42,000/- + 27% HRA (or as per funding agency norms)
Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA for candidates selected through a national-level examination (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship / GATE / DBT-BET or equivalent) or as per funding agency norms

Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA for candidates selected through a national-level examination (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship / GATE / DBT-BET or equivalent) or as per funding agency norms

how_to_apply: Apply to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Dhaval Patel), Gujarat Biotechnology University, Gandhinagar, by filling up the online application form at https://forms.gle/cGghLYtkC2BKbQHV8.
Upload the supporting documents named in the notice (listed below).
Submit the application on or before 4 December 2026.
If applying for both posts, clearly indicate the post(s) applied for.

For queries related to the project, write to [email protected] with the latest credentials. The general query phone number printed in the notice is +91 99099 57407, and the general email is [email protected].
important_instructions: Both posts are purely temporary and co-terminate with the project. Extension beyond the first year depends on a satisfactory annual performance review and the project's financial provisions. Pay may also be fixed as per funding agency norms, as the notice states for both posts. Candidates with at least one SCI / Scopus-indexed research paper are encouraged to apply for the SRF post.

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Gujarat Biotechnology University is an initiative of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat. Its address in the notice is Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City), Gandhinagar, Gujarat - 382355, INDIA. The posts are on a project led by Dr. Dhaval Patel (Principal Investigator, Assistant Professor), with Dr. Jagat Rathod (Assistant Professor) as Co-PI.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 positions in total. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the posts.

rows.pay_per_month: Rs. 42,000/- + 27% HRA (or as per funding agency norms)
Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA for candidates selected through a national-level examination (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship / GATE / DBT-BET or equivalent) or as per funding agency norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For both posts the degree requirement is a Master's Degree in Natural (bioinformatics/computational biology/biotechnology/biochemistry/genetics/human genetics/microbiology/pharmacology/biostatistics or equivalent degree in life sciences) or Agricultural Sciences/MVSc, or a bachelor's degree in engineering or technology or medicine, from a recognized University with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The SRF emolument is Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 27% HRA (or as per funding agency norms). The Project Associate-I emolument is Rs. 31,000/- per month plus 27% HRA for candidates selected through a national-level examination (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship / GATE / DBT-BET or equivalent), or as per funding agency norms; the amount for the lower rate is not printed in the notice. Both posts are initially for 01 year, extendable until the duration of the project (total project duration: 02 years from the date of the first release order). Extension is subject to a satisfactory annual performance review and to the financial provisions of the project. The posts are purely temporary and co-terminate with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Dhaval Patel), Gujarat Biotechnology University, Gandhinagar, by filling up the online application form at https://forms.gle/cGghLYtkC2BKbQHV8 . Upload the supporting documents named in the notice (listed below). Submit the application on or before 4 December 2026. If applying for both posts, clearly indicate the post(s) applied for. Documents named in the notice: Latest CV Proof of date of birth Mark sheets / degree certificates NET / GATE / DBT-BET score card Experience certificates For queries related to the project, write to [email protected] with the latest credentials. The general query phone number printed in the notice is +91 99099 57407, and the general email is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says shortlisted candidates will be informed through email regarding the interview process. The interview date, venue and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Both posts are purely temporary and co-terminate with the project. Extension beyond the first year depends on a satisfactory annual performance review and the project's financial provisions. Pay may also be fixed as per funding agency norms, as the notice states for both posts. Candidates with at least one SCI / Scopus-indexed research paper are encouraged to apply for the SRF post.

rows.details: Application form for SRF and Project Associate-I

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 positions: one Senior Research Fellow (SRF-01) and one Project Associate-I (PA-I-01).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the GBU SRF post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in the listed natural sciences or agricultural sciences/MVSc, or a bachelor's degree in engineering, technology or medicine, with minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA, plus NET / GATE / DBT-BET qualification and two years of documented research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I at GBU?
faq.answer: The same degree with minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA; NET / GATE / DBT-BET qualification is not a condition to apply but decides the higher rate of emolument.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GBU SRF and Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Up to 32 years for SRF and up to 35 years for Project Associate-I, as on the closing date of the advertisement, with relaxation as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GBU SRF and Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: SRF gets Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 27% HRA (or as per funding agency norms). Project Associate-I gets Rs. 31,000/- plus 27% HRA if selected through a national-level examination, or as per funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application form at https://forms.gle/cGghLYtkC2BKbQHV8 and upload the latest CV, proof of date of birth, mark sheets / degree certificates, NET / GATE / DBT-BET score card and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the interview process.

faq.question: Q9. Are the GBU SRF and Project Associate-I posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and co-terminate with the project, initially for 01 year and extendable until the project ends (total 02 years from the first release order).

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for both posts should clearly indicate the post(s) applied for.
